dataPalettes.name: garment-swatches
dataPalettes.purpose: Clothing colors Lena assigns to a piece; rendered only inside 16px swatch circles. Not interface colors; theme-independent.

display.purpose: Greeting in the name band (capped at 40px) and page titles. 1.7647rem = 30px at the default text size.

label-title.purpose: The name on a care label (piece or look) and in the settings preview.

title.purpose: Sheet titles and the first-run invitation.

title-small.purpose: Form headers and sentence-case section titles.

body.purpose: Base size (17px at default, follows iOS Dynamic Type); buttons, rows, inputs (never under 16px).

body-small.purpose: Notices, tags, section meta, hints, care-label lines, the toast.

caption.purpose: Count badges and the inline "Gespeichert" confirmation.

label.purpose: Letterspaced caps for tabs and care-symbol names only; growth capped.

label-small.purpose: The muted "wähl eine" marker beside a required group.

typeScale.root: 17px at the default text size: font: -apple-system-body on iPhone/iPad (Dynamic Type), 106.25% elsewhere

shadows.name: band-lift
shadows.purpose: The woven name band, as if stitched on top.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: The round add button and the floating toast.

shadows.name: sheet-rise
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets over a rgba(15, 21, 36, 0.45) backdrop.

motion.name: stitch-in
motion.purpose: Greeting line and a just-saved look label; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background and color changes of tags and care symbols.

motion.name: toast-timing
motion.purpose: How long a toast stays; "Rückgängig" gets more time.

breakpoints.name: content
breakpoints.purpose: Single column max width; bars center their content to it.

components.name: Name Band
components.description: Woven band in the chosen season with an inset dashed stitch: greeting, one rotating line, the Season Row printed on it.
components.html:
Hallo, Lena

Layering-Saison ist eröffnet.
components.css: .ds-band { position: relative; background: var(--band, #f6e3c8); color: var(--band-ink, #1f2a44); border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px 20px 15px; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px var(--shadow, rgba(31,42,68,0.22)); font-family: var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); } .ds-band::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px; border: 1.5px dashed var(--stitch, #c98a3e); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-band__title { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: min(1.7647rem, 40px); line-height: 1.1; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-band__line { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; opacity: 0.92; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Care Label
components.description: A piece's sewn-in label under its photo, in the piece's own season; flat, with the favorite heart.
components.html:
Blaue Bluse

Oberteil

Blau · Herbst
components.css: .ds-care { position: relative; background: var(--band, #f6e3c8); color: var(--band-ink, #1f2a44); border-radius: 4px; padding: 18px 20px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); } .ds-care::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px; border: 1.5px dashed var(--stitch, #c98a3e); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-care__title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.5294rem; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 500; } .ds-care__kind { margin: -6px 0 0; font-size: 0.8824rem; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-care__line { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8824rem; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one thread-red action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--thread, #b8322a); color: var(--thread-ink, #ffffff); font: 600 1rem/1.2 var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--thread, #b8322a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--chip, #e8ebf1); color: var(--muted, #56617a); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Surface button with a strong hairline: Bearbeiten, Foto ändern, Merken.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9aa3b5); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #1f2a44); font: 500 1rem/1.2 var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--thread, #b8322a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Swing Tag
components.description: Kraft tag with a notched left edge and a punched hole; every filter and selectable choice.
components.css: .ds-tag { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px 0 26px; border: none; border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; clip-path: polygon(12px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 12px 100%, 0 50%); background: var(--kraft-soft, #f2e4db); color: var(--kraft-ink, #2e1f19); font: 500 0.8824rem/1 var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-tag::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 50%; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: -3.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ground, #f5f6f8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(42,32,22,0.25); } .ds-tag--on { background: var(--kraft, #d6ad94); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--thread, #b8322a); }

components.name: Season Symbol
components.description: A laundry care symbol with its season mark, always with its caps name; filled in its own season color when chosen.
components.css: .ds-symbol { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border: none; color: var(--ink, #1f2a44); font-family: var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-symbol__mark { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-symbol--on .ds-symbol__mark { background: var(--autumn, #e2ad6f); color: var(--on-season, #1f2a44); } .ds-symbol__label { font-size: min(0.7059rem, 14px); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #56617a); } .ds-symbol--on .ds-symbol__label { color: var(--ink, #1f2a44); font-weight: 600; } .ds-symbol:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--thread, #b8322a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Surface field with a strong hairline; never under 16px so iOS does not zoom.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #1f2a44); } .ds-field > span { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9aa3b5); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: max(1rem, 16px); caret-color: var(--thread, #b8322a); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #56617a); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--thread, #b8322a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Three text tabs; the active one in thread red with a dashed stitch underline.
components.html: SchrankLooksEinstellungen
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dce5); font-family: var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; height: 62px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--muted, #56617a); font-size: min(0.7059rem, 13px); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab--on { color: var(--thread, #b8322a); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline dashed 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Toast with Undo
components.description: Ink capsule; after a delete it carries one "Rückgängig" action with the dashed thread underline, never red.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 6px 0 18px; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--ink, #1f2a44); color: var(--ground, #f5f6f8); font: 500 0.8824rem/1.3 var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px var(--shadow, rgba(31,42,68,0.22)); } .ds-toast > span { padding: 8px 0; } .ds-toast__action { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: none; border: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: underline dashed; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast__action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ground, #f5f6f8); outline-offset: -4px; border-radius: 22px; }

components.name: Name Ask
components.description: First run only: below the primary action, behind a dashed seam, "Wie heißt du?" with a field and a secondary "Merken".
components.css: .ds-ask { max-width: 360px; padding-top: 22px; border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--line-strong, #9aa3b5); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #1f2a44); } .ds-ask label { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-ask__row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-ask__row input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9aa3b5); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); font: inherit; font-size: max(1rem, 16px); } .ds-ask__row button { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9aa3b5); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: inherit; font: 500 1rem/1.2 var(--font, 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', -apple-system, sans-serif); }

narrative.overview:
Lena is 20; the world is a care label made young, not heritage workwear: soft seasonal thread, blush kraft, a friend's voice. The wardrobe is sewn like the label inside Lena's clothes. A woven name band in the color of the chosen season, with an inset dashed stitch, greets her by name; each piece carries its own sewn-in care label on its detail page; seasons are drawn as care-label symbols in a single 1.5px stroke; filters hang as kraft swing tags with a punched hole; one red thread marks what to do next. Everything else steps back so the clothing photos carry the screen.

The ground is a cool porcelain, never cream, with white surfaces and hairline navy-grey lines. Density is calm and single-column (max 720px), built for one hand at the open wardrobe: 44px minimum targets, primary actions in thumb reach, text tab bar at the bottom. Photos are frameless at 3:4 with only a 4px corner. Type is one family, Jost Variable, self-hosted, and grows with the iPhone's text size; hierarchy comes from size and weight in sentence case; letterspaced caps are kept for tabs and care-symbol names only, and there is no second face.

The system refuses the iOS-settings grey grid: no pill chips, no emoji tabs, no grey-filled list rows.
keyCharacteristics: Woven fabric in the color of the chosen season (pale sage, apricot, ochre or ice blue; deep tinted versions in dark) with a stronger dashed stitch is the only branded surface: the name band on the wardrobe (and its preview in the settings), the care label on a piece or an outfit, the small woven name label of each outfit. Navy is the ink, no longer the fabric.
Kraft swing tags (notched left edge, punched hole) for every filter and selectable choice.
A seasonal thread (sage, apricot, ochre, ice blue) sews every stitch and fills the chosen season; it follows the Season Row.
Thread red reserved for the one primary action, the active tab, destructive actions, errors and the focus/caret affordance.
One 1.5px round-capped stroke system for all pictograms.
Frameless 3:4 photo tiles; the clothing is the star.
Full light and dark token sets, switched by `data-theme` on the root: Settings → "Darstellung" offers Automatisch (follows the iPhone), Hell, Dunkel; garment swatches are a separate data palette.

rules.name: The One Thread Rule
rules.body: Thread red appears only on the primary action (primary button, add button), the active tab, destructive actions, error messages, and the focus ring/caret. Never on decoration, headings, icons at rest, or a second button on the same screen.

rules.name: The Porcelain Rule
rules.body: The ground is cool porcelain (`ground`), never cream or warm off-white. Warmth enters only through kraft and the seasonal thread.

rules.name: The Data Palette Rule
rules.body: Garment swatches describe clothing and appear only inside a swatch circle; they never color interface chrome, and no UI token stands in for a garment color.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Jost Variable only, self-hosted; no external font host at runtime and no second display face.

rules.name: The Caps Are Labels Rule
rules.body: Letterspaced caps name a tab or a symbol, nothing else. Section titles are sentence case. Caps are never a decorative line stacked above another heading.

rules.name: The Growing Text Rule
rules.body: Every font size is a rem step on a 17px root, so the whole ramp follows the reader. On iPhone and iPad the root is `font: -apple-system-body` (Dynamic Type, 17px at the default size), guarded by `@supports (font: -apple-system-body) and (-webkit-touch-callout: none)` so a Mac keeps 17px; elsewhere it is `106.25%`. Fixed rows that cannot wrap (tab labels, care-symbol names, swatch names, the name-band greeting) cap their growth with `min(<rem>, <px>)`; inputs never drop below 16px (`max(1rem, 16px)`) so iOS does not zoom on focus. Never write a font size in px.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every count (section meta, tag badge, action-bar count, backup compare) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Four Lifts Rule
rules.body: Only the name band, the add button, the toast and sheets cast shadows. The care label, the outfit name label and the name-band preview in the settings are sewn into the page and stay flat, as do cards, tiles, chips, rows and buttons; inset shadows are used only for focus, the tag hole and swatch rings.

dos: **Do** keep thread red to the primary action, the active tab, destructive actions, errors and the focus ring/caret.
**Do** use the swing-tag silhouette with its punched hole for every filter value and selectable choice.
**Do** use hairline link rows for references to another screen, not tags.
**Do** draw new pictograms on the 24px grid with a 1.5px round-capped stroke.
**Do** keep photos frameless at 3:4 with 4px corners.
**Do** keep every interactive target at 44px or more and put the primary action in thumb reach.

**Do** define every new UI color in both the light and the dark token set; garment swatches stay theme-independent. Dark rules hang on `[data-theme='dark']`, never on `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (the media query would ignore Lena's choice).
**Do** confirm destructive steps in a confirm sheet with a danger-solid button and the safe action focused.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion` for the stitch-in, the sheet rise and the new-tile settle.
**Do** write font sizes as rem steps of the 17px ramp and cap only rows that cannot wrap.
**Do** offer "Rückgängig" in the toast after deleting instead of a second confirmation.
donts: **Don't** use pill-shaped chips or a grey settings-style grid; choices are kraft tags.
**Don't** use emoji or icon fonts for tabs or symbols.
**Don't** use a cream or warm off-white ground; the ground stays cool porcelain.
**Don't** add a second primary (thread-red) button to a screen.
**Don't** load fonts from an external host or add a second typeface.
**Don't** stack a small caps line above a heading as decoration; caps labels are the heading.
**Don't** add shadows beyond the name band, the add button, the toast and sheets.
**Don't** use garment swatch colors for interface chrome.
**Don't** set a font size in px, or let an input fall below 16px.
